summary: The change adds GET /exports/cases.csv as an alias of case export and turns MFA off for privileged action EXPORT_CASES. That violates MFA-1, the exhaustive route control test fails on the final commit, and CI is red, so CHG-4 fails as well. No approved exception covers the deviation. Process records for the ticket, independent code review, commit coverage, and security review are in order, but the MFA break blocks acceptance.
